title: Describe a famous person you would like to meet

sections.text: Topic 1: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.

sections.heading: Who is she?
sections.text: If I had a chance to meet any influential person, it would undoubtedly be Vivian Wilson, who is an American model. She is a public figure who has remained resilient despite conflicts with her father, Elon Musk. She has also confidently embraced her transgender identity.

chấp nhận và tự hào với bản dạng giới
bản dạng giới chuyển giới

sections.heading: How I knew her
sections.text: When I was doomscrolling my Facebook newsfeed, I stumbled upon her post criticising the biography of Elon Musk. In the book, she is portrayed as rebellious and difficult, and as someone who frequently made rash decisions in defiance of her father, including her decision to transition. To be honest, I was so curious about Vivian Wilson after reading the post that I made up my mind to learn more about her personal life and public image. That said, the more I learnt about her online, the more I came to realise that she wasn't the person the biography made her out to be.

sections.heading: Why she inspires me
sections.text: What interests me most is not so much her family turmoil as her efforts and contributions to society, which are what truly make her stand out. She often speaks up about human rights and equal access to education and healthcare. Those ideas run directly counter to the values and beliefs held by many influential figures across the globe. I find her bravery and willingness to challenge such views genuinely inspiring.

sections.heading: How I would meet her
sections.text: I have always wanted to meet her in person, perhaps in a small and intimate interview, like the ones you may see on talk shows, to tell her how deeply I admire her for her courage and unwavering strength in the face of adversity. I would be curious to know what kept her going during the period when she struggled with gender dysphoria and her parents’ divorce. It must have been challenging for her.

sections.heading: Why it matters to me
sections.text: As someone who is exploring sociology and gender studies, I think a chance to sit down and talk with her would be valuable because she has firsthand experience of many of the challenges faced by transgender people.
